step1_analysis.description: This circuit is a cross-coupled LC VCO core with a differential tuning varactor network. It forms one half of a quadrature VCO, using NFET cross-coupled pairs for negative resistance and MOS varactors for frequency tuning.

paper_reference.title: Low-Power Low-Phase-Noise Differentially Tuned Quadrature VCO Design in Standard CMOS

power_consumption.description: Total DC power dissipated by the oscillator core.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on the saturation current of the cross-coupled NFETs at 1.8V supply.

sky130_expected.calculation: f = 1 / (2 * pi * sqrt(L * C)). With an added 4nH differential inductor and 1.5pF capacitor in the testbench, f ≈ 2.05 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by the LC tank components added in the testbench to match the paper's target frequency.

phase_noise.description: Phase noise at 3MHz offset from the carrier.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Phase noise depends heavily on the tank Q and transistor noise figures. Expected to be in the same ballpark as the paper.

tuning_range.description: Frequency variation across the full tuning voltage range.

sky130_expected.calculation: Delta f = f_max - f_min. Varactor capacitance change is small (~25fF), so tuning range will be around 20-50 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The extracted varactors are relatively small (W=5u, L=0.5u), leading to a smaller tuning range than the paper.

output_amplitude.description: Peak-to-peak voltage swing of the oscillator output.

sky130_expected.calculation: Vpp ≈ I_tail * R_p. With I_tail ~ 10mA and R_p = 250 ohm, Vpp ~ 2.5V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Limited by the supply voltage and tank parallel resistance.

gain.description: Gain of the output buffer or tuning sensitivity.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on the specific buffer design which is not fully present in this core.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure power consumption, oscillation frequency, and output amplitude of the VCO. An LC tank is added to enable oscillation.
step3_testbench.spice:
* VCO Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u

XM1 N0 N1 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N1 N3 N5 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N3 LABEL_NET_0 N5 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N0 N3 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N2 N1 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N4 N3 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N4 N1 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N2 N3 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}

* Biases and Supplies
VLABEL_NET_0 LABEL_NET_0 0 0.9
VDD VDD 0 1.8
Vtune N0 0 1.8
Vtune_b N2 0 0

* Tail connections (Grounding the common sources)
Vtail1 N4 0 0
Vtail2 N5 0 0

* LC Tank (Added to enable oscillation)
L1 VDD N1 2n
L2 VDD N3 2n
R1 N1 VDD 250
R2 N3 VDD 250
C1 N1 N3 1.5p

* Initial conditions to kickstart oscillation
.ic v(N1)=1.8 v(N3)=0

.control
  * DC Analysis for Power
  op
  let power = -i(VDD) * 1.8
  print power

  * Transient Analysis for Oscillation
  tran 10p 20n
  
  * Measure amplitude
  meas tran vmax max v(N1) from=10n to=20n
  meas tran vmin min v(N1) from=10n to=20n
  let vpp = vmax - vmin
  print vpp

  * Measure frequency
  meas tran t_start trig v(N1) val=1.8 rise=15
  meas tran t_end trig v(N1) val=1.8 rise=20
  let period = (t_end - t_start)/5
  let freq_osc = 1/period
  print freq_osc
  
  quit
.endc
